selection.criteria: Thirty clips from seven newer recordings were selected and frozen for scene diversity, camera visibility and complete pose coverage before inference, without filtering by model metrics. Eight historical performance-curated clips are retained. Seven additional quality-approved historical clips were restored for scene/time coverage and available delivery capacity, without using model scores. These seven use existing evaluated results; they were not selected before inference. Every displayed video shows constant arithmetic mean ATE/RPE over all complete local plans within that clip.
